policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV text reads 'But I determined this for myself', rendering the connective as adversative de; the mapped textual_variant note 'Some ancient authorities read For.' puts gar in the margin, so the text follows r01.
English 'who then is he that maketh me glad' needs a copula under either reading; the presence or absence of estin leaves no trace in the ASV and no note is mapped here.
ASV reads simply 'And I wrote this very thing' with no dative pronoun; the added hymin would surface as 'I wrote unto you', which the ASV does not have here or in italics.
'lest, when I came, I should have sorrow' renders either the aorist subjunctive scho or the indicative echo after me; the ASV's modal English does not distinguish mood and no note is mapped here.
ASV text has 'ye should rather forgive him', rendering mallon, and the mapped textual_variant note 'Some ancient authorities omit rather.' assigns the omission to the margin.

ASV order 'for what I also have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything' follows ho kecharismai before ei ti, excluding the RP transposition ei ti kecharismai ho (r02); r00 and r01 differ only in punctuation spacing, which the English cannot distinguish. The mapped note is an alternative_rendering and decides nothing.
ASV reads 'a savor from death unto death', where 'from' renders ek against the bare genitive of the omission.
ASV reads 'a savor from life unto life', where 'from' renders ek against the bare genitive of the omission.
ASV reads 'as the many', rendering hoi polloi; loipoi would give 'the rest', which the ASV does not have. The mapped note concerns the rendering of kapeleuontes and decides nothing here.
'in the sight of God' renders katenanti and katenopion alike, and the ASV cannot show the RP article before theou; the mapped note is an alternative_rendering about kapeleuontes.
